Interface Ir

All Known Subinterfaces:
Ir.Expression, Ir.Statement
All Known Implementing Classes:
Ir.And, Ir.Assign, Ir.Binary, Ir.Body, Ir.Break, Ir.Cast, Ir.Compare, Ir.Conditional, Ir.Const, Ir.Continue, Ir.Eval, Ir.Field, Ir.ForEach, Ir.ForRange, Ir.Helper, Ir.If, Ir.InvokeJava, Ir.InvokePython, Ir.InvokeSibling, Ir.Local, Ir.LocalRef, Ir.ModuleAttribute, Ir.NewJava, Ir.NewPythonException, Ir.Or, Ir.Param, Ir.PutSelf, Ir.PythonMember, Ir.Return, Ir.SelfProperty, Ir.StaticField, Ir.StrJoin, Ir.Throw, Ir.Truthy, Ir.Try, Ir.Unary, Ir.While
public sealed interface Ir permits Ir.Expression, Ir.Statement
The typed intermediate representation of a compiled function body: what the Python side lowers a body into, and what the Java side turns into SourceGen statements. Types are Java type names as TypeDef.of reads them (long, double, boolean, java.lang.String, a class name, [] for arrays); a Python int is a long, a float a double, None a null.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher
